Based on my thorough search, I found the Lightfast login/sign-in page UI components. The codebase does not appear to have a separate "Codex" application folder, but rather the authentication system (sign-in/sign-up) is the central login page for the Lightfast platform. Here's what I found:

## Lightfast Login/Sign-In Page Components

The login/sign-in UI is located at: `/Users/jeevanpillay/Code/@lightfastai/lightfast/apps/app/src/app/(auth)/`

### Main Components:

**1. Sign-In Page** (`sign-in/page.tsx`)
- Header with "Log in to Lightfast" title
- Email form for entering credentials
- OAuth button for GitHub sign-in
- Multi-step flow: email → code verification → session activation
- Handles error states and redirects

**2. Layout** (`layout.tsx`)
- Fixed header with Lightfast logo
- Centered content container (max-width: xs)
- Join Early Access button in top-right
- Responsive design with proper spacing

**3. Email Form Component** (`_components/email-form.tsx`)
- Input field for email address with placeholder "Email Address"
- Submit button "Continue with Email"
- Supports both sign-in and sign-up modes

**4. OAuth Button Component** (`_components/oauth-button.tsx`)
- GitHub OAuth integration using Clerk authentication
- Handles sign-in and sign-up flows
- Shows spinner during loading
- Error handling for waitlist restrictions

**5. Code Verification UI** (`_components/shared/code-verification-ui.tsx`)
- 6-digit OTP input with individual slots
- Auto-verifies when all 6 digits entered
- "Back" and "Resend" buttons
- Error messaging with icon
- Loading states during verification

**6. OTP Island Component** (`_components/otp-island.tsx`)
- Manages OTP sending and verification logic
- Handles both sign-in and sign-up modes
- Ticket-based invitation flow support
- Auto-sends OTP on mount

**7. Session Activator** (`_components/session-activator.tsx`)
- Handles final session creation via ticket
- Redirects to `/account/welcome` on success

**8. Sign-Up Page** (`sign-up/page.tsx`)
- Similar flow to sign-in with invitation ticket support
- Legal compliance text (Terms of Service, Privacy Policy)
- Link to sign-in for existing users

**9. Error Banner Component** (`_components/error-banner.tsx`)
- Displays error messages with red destructive styling
- Handles specific error codes (waitlist, account_not_found)
- Contextual action buttons

**10. Separator Component** (`_components/separator-with-text.tsx`)
- Divider with "Or" text between email and OAuth options

### Key Design Elements:
- Uses Tailwind CSS with custom design tokens (foreground, background, muted-foreground)
- Implements custom button variants (link-blue, outline)
- Uses custom Input and Button components from `@repo/ui`
- Responsive design with proper mobile/tablet support
- OTP inputs with visual separation (gap-2, !rounded-none borders)
- Sentry integration for error tracking and breadcrumbs
- Clerk authentication provider integration

The complete file contents are all shown above. There is no separate "Codex" application - the authentication system IS the login page for the Lightfast platform.

Done. Here's a summary of the changes that now mirror the Codex desktop login page:

**Component (`signed-out-shell.tsx`):**
- Removed `role="dialog"` and `aria-labelledby` (Codex doesn't use them on its login page)
- Removed subtitle text — Codex just has logo + title
- Added `auth-gate__hero` wrapper around logo + title (matches Codex's `flex flex-col items-center gap-8` grouping)
- Moved the massive SVG path data to a `MONOGRAM_D` constant at the bottom of the file

**CSS (`styles.css`):**
- Logo: 52px (was 48px) — matches Codex's `size-[52px]`
- Title: 28px, weight 400, line-height 36px (was 20px, weight 500) — matches Codex's `text-[28px] leading-9 font-normal`
- Buttons: pill-shaped (`border-radius: 9999px`) instead of 6px rounded — matches Codex's `rounded-full`
- Primary button: 48px height, transparent border — matches Codex's `h-[48px]`
- Secondary button: 46px height — matches Codex's `h-[46px]`
- Actions container: 340px max-width (was 200px) — matches Codex's `w-[340px]`
- Hover opacity: 0.8 (was 0.88) — matches Codex's `hover:bg-token-foreground/80`

1	const STORAGE_KEY = "lightfast-desktop:sidebar-collapsed";
2	
3	export interface SidebarController {
4	  isCollapsed(): boolean;
5	  setCollapsed(collapsed: boolean): void;
6	  toggle(): void;
7	}
8	
9	function readPersistedState(): boolean {
10	  try {
11	    return window.localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY) === "true";
12	  } catch {
13	    return false;
14	  }
15	}
16	
17	function writePersistedState(collapsed: boolean): void {
18	  try {
19	    window.localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, String(collapsed));
20	  } catch {
21	    // ignore storage errors (private mode, quota)
22	  }
23	}
24	
25	export function createSidebarController(): SidebarController {
26	  let collapsed = readPersistedState();
27	  apply();
28	
29	  function apply(): void {
30	    document.documentElement.dataset.sidebarCollapsed = String(collapsed);
31	    const trigger = document.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
32	      "[data-sidebar-trigger]"
33	    );
34	    if (trigger) {
35	      trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", String(!collapsed));
36	      trigger.setAttribute(
37	        "aria-label",
38	        collapsed ? "Expand sidebar" : "Collapse sidebar"
39	      );
40	    }
41	  }
42	
43	  return {
44	    isCollapsed() {
45	      return collapsed;
46	    },
47	    setCollapsed(next) {
48	      if (next === collapsed) {
49	        return;
50	      }
51	      collapsed = next;
52	      writePersistedState(collapsed);
53	      apply();
54	    },
55	    toggle() {
56	      this.setCollapsed(!collapsed);
57	    },
58	  };
59	}
